    ```java
    package com.rustypayments;

    import java.time.*;
    import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
    import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
    import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
    import java.util.Set;

    public class ModernPaymentCalendar implements PaymentCalendar {
        private static final ZoneId BANK_ZONE = ZoneId.of("Europe/Warsaw");
        private static final LocalTime CUT_OFF = LocalTime.of(16, 0, 0);
        private static final Set<MonthDay> HOLIDAYS = Set.of(
            MonthDay.of(Month.JANUARY, 1),
            MonthDay.of(Month.JANUARY, 6),
            MonthDay.of(Month.MAY, 1),
            MonthDay.of(Month.MAY, 3),
            MonthDay.of(Month.AUGUST, 15),
            MonthDay.of(Month.NOVEMBER, 1),
            MonthDay.of(Month.NOVEMBER, 11),
            MonthDay.of(Month.DECEMBER, 25),
            MonthDay.of(Month.DECEMBER, 26)
        );

        @Override
        public boolean isBusinessDay(String date) {
            LocalDate ld = parseDate(date);
            if (ld.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || ld.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) {
                return false;
            }
            return !HOLIDAYS.contains(MonthDay.from(ld));
        }

        @Override
        public String processingDate(String submittedAt) {
            ZonedDateTime zdt = parseInstant(submittedAt).withZoneSameInstant(BANK_ZONE);
            LocalDate ld = zdt.toLocalDate();
            LocalTime lt = zdt.toLocalTime();

            if (isBusinessDay(ld) && (lt.isBefore(CUT_OFF) || lt.equals(CUT_OFF))) {
                return ld.toString();
            }
            return nextBusinessDay(ld).toString();
        }

        @Override
        public String settlementDate(String submittedAt) {
            LocalDate processing = LocalDate.parse(processingDate(submittedAt));
            return nextBusinessDay(processing).toString();
        }

        @Override
        public int daysLate(String dueDate, String paidAt) {
            LocalDate due = parseDate(dueDate);
            LocalDate paid = parseInstant(paidAt).withZoneSameInstant(BANK_ZONE).toLocalDate();
            int late = (int) ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(due, paid);
            return Math.max(0, late);
        }

        @Override
        public String addMonths(String date, int months) {
            LocalDate start = parseDate(date);
            boolean isLastDay = start.getDayOfMonth() == start.lengthOfMonth();
            LocalDate result = start.plusMonths(months);
            if (isLastDay) {
                result = result.withDayOfMonth(result.lengthOfMonth());
            }
            return result.toString();
        }

        private LocalDate parseDate(String date) {
            if (date == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null date");
            try {
                return LocalDate.parse(date);
            } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid date: " + date);
            }
        }

        private ZonedDateTime parseInstant(String instant) {
            if (instant == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null instant");
            try {
                return ZonedDateTime.parse(instant);
            } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
                // ZonedDateTime.parse requires an offset/zone.
                // ISO-8601 like 2026-03-27T16:45:00+01:00 is handled.
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid instant: " + instant);
            }
        }

        private LocalDate nextBusinessDay(LocalDate date) {
            LocalDate next = date.plusDays(1);
            while (!isBusinessDay(next.toString())) {
                next = next.plusDays(1);
            }
            return next;
        }

        private boolean isBusinessDay(LocalDate ld) {
            if (ld.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || ld.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) {
                return false;
            }
            return !HOLIDAYS.contains(MonthDay.from(ld));
        }
    }
    ```
